brief: 68 s vertical reel, rebuild of the finished cut 00_REFERENCE_perfectionist_ep1.mp4 as an Edits DRAFT so Meta keeps the project data. Main track: 01_TALK_cut_with_DJI_mic_audio.mp4, use it whole (already cut and synced, DJI mic audio). Add the 14 B clips (B01..B14) as overlays at the times and positions in 04_shot_list.txt: 'chest' = lower box over his chest (face visible), 'head' = upper box over his face, 'tall' = narrow box over his chest. Captions are REQUIRED: the reference has burned-in captions (white, lowercase, lower third); in Edits use auto captions in the same position and fix spelling per 03_captions.srt (asana, lat control, whose mat). Compare with 00_REFERENCE before saving. Save as draft 'Yogi superpower 1 Perfectionist'. Do not post. If 00_REFERENCE or 01_TALK is missing from the folder (Drive upload limit from the cloud is 10 MB; Boonchu adds them by hand), set status needs-boonchu.
